ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $O$ is any point inside the equilateral triangle $ABC$. Lines $OD$, $OE$, and $OF$ are drawn through point $O$ parallel to $AB$, $AC$, and $BC$, respectively, intersecting $AC$, $BC$, and $AB$ at points $G$, $H$, and $I$. Given that the perimeter of the equilateral triangle $ABC$ is 18, what is the sum of $OD + OE + OF$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\triangle ABC$ is an equilateral triangle with a perimeter of 18, \\
$\therefore$ $\angle B=\angle C=\angle A=60^\circ$, AC=6\\
Since OD$\parallel$AB, OE$\parallel$AC, and OF$\parallel$BC, \\
$\therefore$ Quadrilateral OHCF is a parallelogram, Quadrilateral AEOG is a parallelogram, $\angle C=\angle OHD=\angle GFO=60^\circ$, $\angle ODH=\angle B=60^\circ$, $\angle OGF=\angle A=60^\circ$\\
$\therefore$ $\triangle ODH$ and $\triangle OGF$ are equilateral triangles, OH=CF\\
$\therefore$ OD=OH, OF=FG, OE=AG\\
$\therefore$ OD=CF,\\
Since AC=AG+GF+CF\\
$\therefore$ AC=OE+OF+OE=6.\\
Thus, the answer is: $\boxed{6}$.
